mapper.insert: INSERT INTO embedding_songs ( id, song_id, embedding_type, model_name, dimension, source_text, vector, qdrant_collection, qdrant_point_id, is_indexed, indexed_at ) VALUES ( UUID(), #{songId}, #{embeddingType}, #{modelName}, #{dimension}, #{sourceText}, #{vector, typeHandler=com.ssafy.revibek.embedding.mapper.JsonFloatListTypeHandler}, #{qdrantCollection}, #{qdrantPointId}, #{isIndexed}, #{indexedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE model_name = VALUES(model_name), dimension = VALUES(dimension), source_text = VALUES(source_text), vector = VALUES(vector), qdrant_collection = VALUES(qdrant_collection), qdrant_point_id = VALUES(qdrant_point_id), is_indexed = VALUES(is_indexed), indexed_at = VALUES(indexed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM embedding_songs WHERE song_id = #{songId} AND embedding_type = #{embeddingType}
